question: Describe the impact of patient age on radiation sensitivity.
question_raw: Describe the impact of patient age on radiation sensitivity.
answer: Individuals exposed at early ages are the most radiosensitive as the primary damage has a longer latent phase to outbreak into cancer. After that,  sensitivity to radiation decreases until maturity, but it increases again at older ages .

question_raw: Summarize the benefits and limitations of ultrasound as an imaging modality

question: Compare the role of screening mammography versus diagnostic mammography
question_raw: Compare the role of screening mammography versus diagnostic mammography
answer: Screening Mammography    - done for asymptomatic patients  -  Identifies  abnormality but does not characterize it  - reduces breast cancer mortality  Diagnostic Mammography  - done for symptomatic patients (i.e. palpable lump)  - typically after abnormal screening mammogram  - patient with history of breast cancer --> breast biopsy may also be seen as diagnostic patient  - characterizes abnormality using specialized mammographic techniques (spot compression magnification views / 90 degree view / step obliques)
answer_raw:
Screening Mammography  
- done for asymptomatic patients 
- Identifies abnormality but does not characterize it 
- reduces breast cancer mortality 

Diagnostic Mammography 
- done for symptomatic patients (i.e. palpable lump) 
- typically after abnormal screening mammogram 
- patient with history of breast cancer --> breast biopsy may also be seen as diagnostic patient 
- characterizes abnormality using specialized mammographic techniques (spot compression magnification views / 90 degree view / step obliques)
